rationale: Untrusted relative paths (pack manifest members, content and kit archive entries, declared assets, template and importer paths) are now screened by one header-only helper, pulp::runtime::is_safe_relative_path, which refuses rooted forms on every platform. The design-source-ingest and render-assets-and-backends touches are the import-emit write plan and the widget-bridge asset path guard, which now refuse more names, never fewer. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
